'''Donaldson''' is a [[Languages of Scotland|Scottish]] and [[Irish language|Irish]] patronymic surname meaning "son of [[Donald]]". It is a simpler Anglicized variant for the name [[Macdonald (name)|MacDonald]]. Notable people with the surname include:
